note: Real DoJ-released court documents with documented, defective redactions. The PDFs themselves are NOT committed — they contain the very content their failed redactions exposed, and we are a redaction/DSAR company, so we don't store improperly-disclosed third-party data in the repo. Fetch them on demand into examples/real/ (gitignored) with `npm run examples:real`; integrity is checked by SHA-256. tests/real-examples.test.ts asserts on these when present and skips when absent.
